evals.prompt: Prepare the dataset at evals/files/raw_data.jsonl for fine-tuning in alpaca format. Validate quality and report statistics.
evals.expected_output: JSONL file in alpaca format with instruction/input/output/text fields. Deduplication report. Quality warnings for short outputs. Average text length reported.
assertions: Output JSONL has instruction, input, output, text fields

evals.prompt: Convert evals/files/raw_data.jsonl to sharegpt format using 'instruction' as human and 'output' as assistant columns.
evals.expected_output: JSONL file with conversations field containing [{from: human, value: ...}, {from: gpt, value: ...}] pairs.
assertions: Conversations have human and gpt turns
